##### Project general facts

Mar Casa is a majestic residential landmark, embodying the fluidity of ocean waves in its exceptional design. This stunning development features a collection of meticulously crafted apartments, each designed to enhance panoramic ocean views with airy and well-balanced living spaces that delight the senses. Mar Casa is not just a residence, but a testament to emotional luxury living in the birthplace of Dubai.

Each residence features an Advanced IP Intercom system for seamless communication and accessibility, a Smart Access Control system for secure entry to public areas, and a Smart Home system allowing residents to effortlessly control their living spaces. The building's majestic presence and thoughtful amenities create a lifestyle of convenience, security, and modern sophistication.

Every residence at Mar Casa is crafted with high-grade laminate finishes on wardrobes and doors, branded sanitaryware and accessories, and stone or porcelain tiles depending on the unit type. Walls and ceilings feature painted finishes, while kitchens are equipped with high-end branded appliances. The meticulous attention to detail and premium materials ensure each home is a sanctuary of elegance and comfort.


##### Location description and benefits


Nestled in Dubai Maritime City, an iconic manmade peninsula developed under the visionary leadership of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, this exceptional location offers a unique blend of live, work, and play destinations. The area features retail spaces, residential areas, office towers, and a picturesque promenade, creating a dynamic and integrated community.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity and vibrant surroundings. Connected to the old city, the financial centre of Dubai, and the beautiful Jumeirah area with its vibrant nightlife and wide range of entertainment, health facilities, schools, parks, and malls – all just minutes away – residents enjoy effortless access to the best of Dubai.

For those seeking a residence that embodies ocean-inspired luxury, modern convenience, and a prestigious address, Dubai Maritime City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of waterfront living, strategic positioning, and a dynamic community makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — sophisticated, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
